{%- liquid
  assign og_title = page_title | default: shop.name
  assign og_url = canonical_url | default: request.origin
  assign og_url = og_url | split: '?' | first
  assign og_type = 'website'
  assign og_description = page_description | default: shop.description | default: shop.name
  assign default_social_image_alt = 'Rhino Lapidary brand image with logo on a dark background'
  assign default_social_image_url = 'rhino-og-default.jpg' | asset_url
  assign social_image = nil
  assign social_image_alt = ''
  assign social_image_height = ''
  assign social_image_url = ''
  assign social_image_width = ''

  if request.page_type == 'product'
    assign og_type = 'product'
    if rhino_legacy_content == false
      assign og_title = product.title
      assign og_description = ''
    endif
    assign product_social_image = product.featured_media.preview_image | default: product.featured_image
    if product_social_image and rhino_legacy_content
      assign social_image = product_social_image
      assign product_social_image_alt = product.featured_media.alt | default: product_social_image.alt
      if product_social_image_alt != blank
        assign social_image_alt = product_social_image_alt
      endif
    endif
  elsif request.page_type == 'article'
    assign og_type = 'article'
    if article.image
      assign social_image = article.image
    endif
  elsif request.page_type == 'collection'
    if collection.image
      assign social_image = collection.image
    endif
  elsif request.page_type == 'password'
    assign og_url = request.origin
  endif

  if social_image
    assign social_image_width = social_image.width | default: 1200
    assign social_image_height = social_image.height | default: 630
    assign social_image_url = social_image | image_url: width: social_image_width

    if social_image_alt == blank and social_image.alt != blank
      assign social_image_alt = social_image.alt
    endif
  endif

  if social_image_alt == blank
    if request.page_type == 'product' and product.title != blank
      assign social_image_alt = product.title
    elsif request.page_type == 'collection' and collection.title != blank
      assign social_image_alt = collection.title
    elsif request.page_type == 'article' and article.title != blank
      assign social_image_alt = article.title
    else
      assign social_image_alt = default_social_image_alt
    endif
  endif

  if social_image_url == blank
    assign social_image_url = default_social_image_url
    assign social_image_width = 1200
    assign social_image_height = 630
    assign social_image_alt = default_social_image_alt
  endif

  assign social_image_url_prefix = social_image_url | slice: 0, 2

  if social_image_url contains 'http://'
    assign social_image_url = social_image_url | replace_first: 'http://', 'https://'
  elsif social_image_url_prefix == '//'
    assign social_image_url = social_image_url | prepend: 'https:'
  elsif social_image_url != blank
    assign social_image_url = social_image_url | prepend: request.origin
  endif
%}

<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="{{ og_title | escape }}">
{%- if og_description != blank -%}
<meta name="twitter:description" content="{{ og_description | escape }}">
{%- endif -%}
{%- if social_image_url != blank -%}
  <meta name="twitter:image" content="{{ social_image_url }}">

{%- endif -%}
